hero.eyebrow: PLAYER CAREER SIMULATOR · FREE IN YOUR BROWSER
hero.title: Copero: Build Your Own Football Career
hero.lead: Create one footballer, shape a unique set of attributes and follow the career from the first academy offer to the final whistle. Copero turns your choices into seasons, transfers, trophies, international call-ups and a career result you can share.

intro.title: One player. An entire football life.
paragraphs: The search for “Copero build your own football career” is really a search for agency: you want to name the player, choose the role and see whether your decisions create a prospect, a loyal club hero or a world-class career. This page starts with the playable builder because the important part is not reading about a career. It is making one.

Copero is a decision-based football career simulator, not a real-time match game. You do not control every pass. You define the player, build an attribute profile through the legend draft, choose a starting club and respond when the career reaches a turning point. The simulator records what follows and keeps the full run together until retirement.

stages.title: How to build your football career in Copero
stages.body: Every run follows four clear stages. Your choices stay connected, so the player you build at the start affects the opportunities that appear later.

items.title: Create the footballer
items.body: Choose a surname, shirt number, preferred foot, nationality and position. You can also add a family nationality. Position is more than a label: it changes how the game values your final attribute mix and what a successful season looks like.

items.title: Draft the player DNA
items.body: Eight football legends appear across eight rounds. Take one still-empty attribute from each: pace, shooting, passing, dribbling, defending, physicality, skill moves or weak foot. Every accepted choice locks that slot, making the order of your decisions matter.

items.title: Choose the first club
items.body: After the card is complete, compare the available starting clubs. Reputation can open a bigger stage, while a different offer may provide a clearer route to minutes and development. There is no automatic best badge for every player.

items.title: Live the career
items.body: Advance through seasons, objectives, contracts, loans, transfers, events and possible national-team calls. When the run reaches retirement, Copero gathers the clubs, appearances, goals, assists, trophies, wealth and peak rating into a final career card.

draft.title: Eight legends. Eight attributes.
draft.body: You are not spending points on a blank template. You are assembling a footballer from one irreversible choice at a time. Taking elite shooting now can mean leaving a better dribbling option behind. Filling a low-priority slot too early can force a difficult pick later. The player is yours because the trade-offs are yours.

modes.name: CLASSIC
modes.body: See the numbers and use rerolls while learning how each attribute fits your position.

modes.name: PURIST
modes.body: Draft without visible ratings or rerolls and trust what you know about the legends.

decisions.title: The career changes when your choices do

items.title: Build for the role
items.body: A striker can chase finishing and movement, while a creator needs passing and dribbling. Defenders and goalkeepers are not judged by striker numbers, so start with the career you actually want to see.

items.title: Read the club situation
items.body: A famous destination is tempting, but squad role and playing time matter to development. Compare the opportunity in front of your player instead of treating reputation as the only signal.

items.title: Own the turning points
items.body: Transfers, loans, objectives and career events create trade-offs. Staying can build continuity; moving can raise the level. The simulator is designed to produce a story, not reveal one guaranteed winning route.

result.title: Your whole career becomes one result
result.body: Retirement does not erase the path. Copero keeps the season history and turns the run into a career summary with a final grade. Download or share the result card, then change the position, draft or decisions and see how different the next football life becomes.

items.question: Can I build my own football career in Copero?
items.answer: Yes. Create the player, complete the eight-attribute legend draft, select a starting club and guide the career through seasons and decisions until retirement.

items.question: Is this Copero football career game free?
items.answer: Yes. The game runs in a modern browser without an account or client download. Advertising supports the site, but the career builder itself does not require payment.

items.question: Do I control football matches in real time?
items.answer: No. Copero focuses on player building and career decisions. The simulator resolves seasons and statistics while you choose the identity, attributes, clubs and responses at important moments.

items.question: Will my football career be saved?
items.answer: The active career is stored locally in the browser, so you can return on the same browser and continue. It is not an online account or a permanent cloud profile.

items.question: Is copero.top an official Copero product?
items.answer: No. copero.top is an independent football career simulator and is not affiliated with Copero, football clubs, competitions or players.

finalCta.title: Build the player. Make the calls. Keep the story.
finalCta.body: Your first decision takes seconds. The career it creates can travel much further.
